title: explicit solvers: the warning about the PostNewton step is wrong
author: Claude-JG
description: The warning added for #830 (revision2026b RG4.15.3) says that explicit solvers do not perform the PostNewton step; they do, after every step, through the discontinuous iteration of CSolverBase. The warning is removed; found in revision2026b step RG4.16.1.
releaseNotes: the warning at the start of an explicit solve about objects with a PostNewton step is removed: it was wrong - explicit solvers perform the PostNewton step after every step, like the implicit solvers
